newsitem.title: BULGARIA: YIELDS FALL ON BULGARIA 1-,4-WEEK DISCOUNT T-BILLS.
newsitem.headline: YIELDS FALL ON BULGARIA 1-,4-WEEK DISCOUNT T-BILLS.

text.p: Yields fell at Thursday's
auctions of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry one-week and four-week
discount T-bills, central bank figures showed.
The average yields to maturity of the two issues were 1.48
percent and 7.75 percent, respectively, down from 1.62 and 9.11
percent at Wednesday's auctions.
Bids were received for a total of 83.979 billion levs of
T-bills for today's auctions but the ministry approved bids for
58.899 billion lev worth.
The issues were offered with par values of 25 billion levs
and 40 billion levs respectively and no minimum acceptable
prices set in advance. Auction date and issue date for each
issue overlap.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
